engineDelta: Since Round 1 the engine gained: cupSeam (sweetheart+princess bustier front split), yoke (bodice yoke split -> Front/Back Yoke + Front/Back Body), and a placket-on-top wearability fix.
rule: WEARABLE = out.issues.length===0 AND the drafted spec faithfully matches the flat. A yoke that drafts but requires dropping the flat's collar, or that does not gather where the flat gathers, is still PARTIAL. No inflation.

attemptedButHeld.flat: #13 doll dress: chest yoke seam, Peter-Pan collar, puff sleeve, A-line body from the yoke
attemptedButHeld.whyHeld: yoke:1 produces a true yoke split (Front Yoke + Front Body + Back Yoke + Back Body). BUT the flat's Peter-Pan collar forces a neck facing, and yoke:1 + a neck facing hits a validator bug: the facing check looks for the pre-split piece names ('Front body piece'/'Back body piece') that the yoke split renamed, so it reports them as missing -> 2 issues. To reach 0 issues you must DROP the collar (bias binding), which drops a defining feature. Faithful draft is NOT 0-issue yet.

attemptedButHeld.flat: #16 babydoll dress: Peter-Pan collar, puff sleeve, body clearly GATHERED into a yoke seam, full A-line babydoll body
attemptedButHeld.whyHeld: Two reasons it stays partial: (1) same yoke+collar/facing validator bug (2 issues with the Peter-Pan collar). (2) Even with the collar dropped and yoke:1 on a gathered skirt, the plain yoke split does NOT add fullness AT the yoke seam — the flat clearly gathers the body into the yoke; the engine gathers the skirt, not the yoke-to-body seam. Structurally still an approximation. yoke has no 'gathered' variant (vocab: yoke=[none, plain]).

attemptedButHeld.flat: #12 swing TOP: Peter-Pan collar, puff sleeve, center inverted box pleat hanging from a yoke

Separately, the flat's defining CENTER INVERTED BOX PLEAT swing body is still not representable. Blocked on both the yoke-on-top bug and the box-pleat gap.

learnings.capability: yoke:1 + neck facing (collar or edgeFinish:facing) validator bug
learnings.note: When yoke:1 is set AND a neck facing exists (any collarType, or edgeFinish:facing), the facing validator looks for the pre-split piece names 'Front body piece'/'Back body piece'. The yoke split renamed them to Front Yoke/Front Body, so it wrongly reports them MISSING -> 2 issues. Reproduce: dress + yoke:1 + edgeFinish:1 => 2 [facing] issues; dress + yoke:1 + biasBinding => 0 issues. This single fix would let #13 draft its collar faithfully at 0 issues. Cheapest, highest-value Round-3 fix (mirrors the placket-on-top fix pattern: the validator wasn't taught the new piece names).

yoke:1 on garment=top always yields '[top] Front piece missing / Back piece missing' because the top-completeness check looks for the pre-split 'Front piece'/'Back piece' names. Same root cause as rank 1 (validator not taught the yoke piece names), but on the top code path. Works on dresses; broken on tops.

learnings.capability: Gathered yoke (fullness AT the yoke-to-body seam) and swing/center inverted box-pleat body
learnings.note: yoke vocab is [none, plain] only. Babydoll flats gather the body into the yoke seam; swing flats hang a center box pleat from a yoke. Even with the rank-1/2 bugs fixed, the plain yoke split won't add this fullness -> still an approximation. Needs a gathered/pleated yoke variant.
